title: First Exploration of the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation, the Tianji Record in his arms suddenly violently trembled, and a line of golden text never seen before appeared on the yellowed pages—that was precisely the condition for breaking the shackles. Three-tenths of one's lifespan, thirty years of yang life, in exchange for a moment of Heavenly Secrets freedom.

text.content: The gate to the seventh layer of the Forbidden Grounds slowly opened before Chen Ji, thick darkness gushing out like a tide, carrying a stench of decay and antiquity. The darkness beyond that gate seemed alive, writhing and probing, as if assessing the worth of the visitor. Chen Ji stood outside the threshold, his robes fluttering in the chilling wind seeping through the door crack, but he did not retreat. Instead, he slightly narrowed his eyes, carefully sensing the familiar aura emanating from that darkness. Mo Xiansheng's words still echoed in his ears—the mysterious benefactor who had always hidden in the mist was finally about to reveal their true face.

dialogue.content: Young master, be careful in everything. The seventh layer of the Forbidden Grounds is extraordinary. Though I can communicate with your spiritual sense through the Tianji Record, I cannot personally enter this place. Everything depends on your own judgment.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, merely nodding slightly before probing his spiritual sense into the Tianji Record in his arms, confirming that the yellowed pages were still faintly warm. After doing this, he took a deep breath, stepped across the threshold. The darkness instantly swallowed him, biting cold assaulting from all directions, as if countless eyes were watching him from the shadows. Beneath his feet was solid blue stone ground, and about ten zhang ahead, a massive stone tablet faintly glowed in the darkness, the characters on it moving like living things.

Chen Ji moved forward slowly, each step taken with extreme caution. His gaze remained fixed on that stone tablet, and as the distance closed, the characters on the tablet gradually became clear—these were not ordinary inscriptions, but a complete set of Tianji Art cultivation methods! Chen Ji's heart jolted. Tianji Art was an untransmitted secret; ordinary cultivators could hardly glimpse its门槛 even in a lifetime, yet now such a complete method was displayed openly on a stone tablet, exposed in this completely unguarded Forbidden Grounds.

dialogue.content: This method... Young master, have you discovered any clue?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately; instead, he walked halfway around the stone tablet, his gaze sweeping from the beginning to the end of the cultivation method. This set of methods appeared complete but was filled with traps at every turn, each layer's cultivation technique hiding profound mysteries—one misstep would lead to deviation and self-destruction. However, just as he was about to look away, a line of small characters deliberately carved at the bottom of the stone tablet suddenly caught his eye—"Exchange life for life, break shackles with shackles." These nine characters exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder, and he suddenly realized something.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng, I understand now. The Tianji Record itself is the first ring of the Heavenly Dao's shackles, isn't it?

...Young master is indeed exceptionally wise. The Tianji Record allows its holder to peer into Heavenly Secrets and foresee the future, seeming like an enormous fortuitous encounter, but in truth, every use deepens the binding with the Heavenly Dao. When the binding becomes deep enough, the holder can no longer escape the manipulation of the Heavenly Dao, becoming a true piece on the board. And the method on this stone tablet is precisely the solution left behind by the one who created the Tianji Record—exchange life for life, break shackles with shackles.

text.content: After hearing this, Chen Ji fell silent for a long while. He should have realized long ago—there is no such thing as a free meal in this world. The reason he could travel the world despite being considered trash was precisely the foresight granted by the Tianji Record, yet every use unknowingly pushed him deeper into the abyss. The handiwork of the Heavenly Dao truly leaves nothing to chance. However, just as he was digesting this information, heavy footsteps suddenly echoed from the darkness, accompanied by a suffocating pressure.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to look, and a massive figure slowly emerged from the darkness. It was a giant clad in black armor, its entire body composed of jet-black rocks, its two eyes burning with eerie green flames. Standing about three zhang tall, it emanated an ancient and desolate aura, clearly the guardian of this Forbidden Grounds. The guardian lowered its head to gaze down at Chen Ji, who was no bigger than an ant, and snorted coldly: How dare a person of impure blood attempt to enter the core of the Forbidden Grounds? Leave quickly, or do not blame this one for being merciless.

choice.prompt: The guardian refused Chen Ji entry to the core area on grounds of impure blood. Facing this existence with unfathomable strength, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to evade the guardian's attacks and forcefully break into the core area. Extremely high risk, but if successful, one can first contact the key to breaking the shackles.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate (estimated 10-15 points)
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain the key information for breaking the shackles
choices.risk_hint: The guardian's strength far exceeds imagination; forcing through may cause a dramatic drop in Heavenly Fate or even death on the spot
choices.process_label: 天机运转三息，预见攻击轨迹

text.content: Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes, and the Tianji Record's foresight instantly activated. The guardian's movements became like slow motion in his vision; every attack trajectory, every timing of openings, all presented clearly in his mind. However, just as he prepared to move, a violent dizziness struck—the guardian's attack actually exceeded the scope of the Tianji Record's foresight!

Wrong! Chen Ji was greatly alarmed in his heart. The Tianji Record could only foresee matters within three hours into the future, yet this strike from the guardian contained some power of temporal laws, completely beyond the range of ordinary foresight. At the critical moment, he could only dodge to the side to avoid vital points. The giant fist grazed his shoulder and crashed into the ground, splashing countless碎石. Agonizing pain came from his shoulder; Chen Ji gritted his teeth and bore it, thinking in his heart: This strike, I've noted it.

choices.description: Use the Forbidden Grounds' historical information provided by Mo Xiansheng to find loopholes in the blood verification, and win through strategy. Lower risk, but requires more time to set up.
choices.visible_cost: Consume considerable time, may alert other forces
choices.visible_reward: Gain the guardian's recognition, officially obtain qualification to enter the core area
choices.risk_hint: Though the guardian is powerful, it is not unreasonable. The key lies in finding a reasonable point of entry

dialogue.content: The elder speaks of impure blood, but I wonder which bloodline is being referred to? As far as this junior knows, the transmission of the Tianji Record is not limited to any particular clan, but prioritizes talent and fortune. Where does the elder's talk of bloodlines originate?

text.content: Upon hearing this, the green flames in the guardian's eyes flickered slightly, clearly not expecting this ant-like human to dare argue with itself. After a moment, it replied in a booming voice: The transmission of the Tianji Record indeed does not depend on bloodline, but this is the place where the Tianji Record originated. Naturally, the bloodline of the original transmitter serves as the standard. And the blood flowing in you is not that of the original lineage.

choices.description: 表面上服从守护者的命令退走，实则暗中观察守护者的弱点，寻找其他进入核心区域的途径。表面 comply with the guardian's order to leave, while secretly observing the guardian's weaknesses and searching for other paths into the core area.
choices.visible_cost: 可能错失最佳时机，被其他势力抢先。May miss the best timing, other forces may get there first.
choices.visible_reward: 发现守护者的致命弱点，获得日后对付他的筹码。Discover the guardian's fatal weakness, gain leverage for dealing with him later.
choices.risk_hint: 守护者可能派人监视，退走过程中需演技精湛。The guardian may send someone to monitor; excellent acting required during the retreat.

dialogue.content: Since the elder says so, this junior shall take his leave. But this junior ventures to ask—if the elder has guarded this place for ten thousand years, has the elder ever seen one who could truly break the shackles?

text.content: The guardian was clearly touched by this question. After a long silence, it slowly replied: Never. Those arrogant prodigies came and went; not a single one passed the blood verification. There was a crazy old man who stayed here for three years, but in the end, he left on his own.

Chen Ji's heart stirred. The crazy old man was clearly a former host of Mo Xiansheng. Just as he was about to press for more details, the guardian seemed to have lost patience, waving its massive arm: Enough. This one has said enough. No matter how silver-tongued you are, impure blood is impure blood—this is Heavenly Dao law, unchangeable by anyone. If you insist on forcing entry, prepare to fall here.

Just as the atmosphere became tense as a drawn sword, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms suddenly violently vibrated. The yellowed pages opened on their own, golden light shining from between the pages, illuminating this ancient darkness. Upon seeing that light, the green flames in the guardian's eyes sharply contracted, and it actually stepped back half a pace: This is... the Tianji Record's true form? Impossible, how could it be in your hands?

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record in his arms. On the yellowed pages, a line of never-before-seen golden characters was appearing. Those characters were ancient and mysterious, emanating a terrifying pressure that made hearts palpitate, resonating with the methods on the stone tablet. He gazed at those characters, each stroke seeming to brand itself into his soul. The condition for breaking the shackles had finally emerged—sacrifice three-tenths of one's lifespan. Thirty years of yang life, in exchange for a moment of Heavenly Secrets freedom.

dialogue.content: Young master, three-tenths of one's lifespan is no small matter. At your current cultivation, your lifespan is approximately one hundred and fifty years; sacrificing three-tenths means losing forty-five years of life. But if you can break all the shackles before your lifespan is exhausted, this sacrifice will be worthwhile. If not... Sigh, this old one can only say that the Tianji Record choosing you may have been a gamble from the very beginning.

text.content: The guardian was silent for a long while before finally speaking: Since the Tianji Record has recognized you as its master, this one will no longer obstruct. But the core area is filled with dangers; if you insist on entering, life and death are your own responsibility. However, this one can tell you one thing—when that crazy old man left back then, he left a line of characters on the back of the stone tablet. Perhaps it will be useful to you. Having said this, the guardian stepped aside. The back of the stone tablet covered with cultivation methods was now facing Chen Ji, and indeed there was another line of small characters on it.

Chen Ji circled to the back of the stone tablet and gazed intently. That line of characters was carved extremely shallow; one would never notice it without careful examination: "The shackles have nine layers, one layer at a time, greed leads to self-destruction." Chen Ji silently recited this sentence, understanding dawning in his heart. The Tianji Record's shackles were not to be removed all at once but required gradual progress. And what he was facing now might only be the condition for breaking the first layer of shackles. Thirty years of lifespan, in exchange for breaking the first layer of shackles—this transaction was worth attempting.
